parameters.copyRatioCoordinates: Source START-mm10 and END-mm10 retained as zero-based, half-open start and end
parameters.expressionTransform: For each gene, z-score VST batch-corrected expression across observed samples using population standard deviation (ddof=0); missing values remain NaN
parameters.geneAnnotations: GENCODE M25 gene and exon models on canonical chromosomes; one-based inclusive GTF coordinates converted to zero-based half-open; overlapping isoform exons compressed; labels scored by NCBI PubMed link count
